svg.aria-label: Inside a trained LSTM on the 40-step memory task: the most informative cell unit moves positive or negative at step 1 depending on the bit and then grows to a steady value of about plus or minus 4, because at every step it keeps about 82 percent of its memory and writes a candidate whose sign matches the stored bit
